b: Eleven weeks ago the floating castle of Aincrad sank into the clouds above Tokyo, and the game's rules came down with it. Everyone in the merge zone now has an HP bar, a level, skills and an inventory they open by thinking. Monsters from the lower floors step through seams in the sky and spawn in…

wd.vibe: Short scenes, real numbers, and people who say less than they mean and show up anyway. Feelings come out in what someone does with their hands.

b: You and your whole university class are pulled out of a lecture in one white flash, into a magical fantasy world called Alacria: a world filled with magic, thousands of species, and things that seem to defy the laws of physics. A beautiful lady in shimmering silk says you were all summoned here…

You died on Earth and woke in Vessary, a river city where magic runs like electricity. Meridian Academy ranks its students by the mana they can draw through the Plumb, and it has put you on the Null Bench, the lowest class, because your Reading came back as zero. A living body should never read…

wd.vibe: Dry, orderly and tense, like a school where every seat is a number. People here answer the question next to the one you asked.

b: Three weeks after tallow fever started raising the dead across coastal Georgia, the interstate north of Cordele is a parking lot of abandoned cars, and the town has shrunk to a few blocks around Southgate Veterinary Clinic. You lead eleven survivors who sleep in the exam rooms and the kennel, and…

wd.vibe: Grounded and bleak, with small kindnesses that cost something. Long quiet stretches broken by violence. Medicine and water decide who lives.

b: Tokyo, present day. Since the spring, criminals whose crimes have been in the news keep dying of heart attacks, and the death toll has passed three hundred. The media calls the killer Kira. Interpol has sent agents, and a detective called L has taken the case without ever showing his face. The…

wd.vibe: cold, watchful and slow; people speak carefully around the word Kira and let silences do the arguing

b: Ten years ago gates opened across the world, and each one spills monsters into the city unless an awakened hunter clears it. The Hunter Association ranks those hunters from E to S and posts their raids. This morning a B-rank gate opened in the Gwanghwamun Station concourse in Seoul, and the…

wd.vibe: tense and dry; people talk about the dead like weather, and nobody says the word double until someone has to

b: Gotham City, late autumn, after dark. The Joker walked out of Arkham Asylum last night, and the commissioner stood in front of the cameras this evening to tell the city to stay indoors. Half the GCPD is working overtime in the Narrows, and the other half is busy with envelopes nobody will name on…

wd.vibe: Cold, watchful and close-grained, with the worst news always arriving through someone you know. People answer the question they wish you had asked.

b: Japan, the present day, where eight people in ten are born with a Quirk, a power that is theirs alone. Three weeks ago the League of Villains broke into a hero agency in Hosu and walked out again, and UA, the national hero school, has moved its first-years into a new dorm on campus where they can…

wd.vibe: Bright on the surface and tired underneath, with bad news said flat. Teachers set drills instead of saying they are afraid, and students talk about their Quirks when they mean themselves.

b: Night City, 2077. Six million people live in a concrete cage between the Pacific and the Badlands. The megacorps own everything above the twentieth floor, and the gangs own everything below it. You are a nobody in Watson, and the fixer who fed you jobs cut you loose after the last one went…

wd.vibe: Tired, transactional, and cold in the mornings. Everyone quotes a price before they admit a feeling, and nobody says the word debt out loud until they have to.

b: Toledo, Ohio, late November 2026. You finished college in May, moved back into your mother's house in Point Place, and still have no job. A one-bedroom lease in the Old West End starts in three weeks. Tomorrow morning a freight company in Louisville wants you in a chair for an interview, six hours…

wd.vibe: Quiet, gray and specific, with the family table as the loudest room. People say the practical thing and mean the other one.

b: Tokyo, present day. Ghouls live in the city among humans, and most people never learn that the quiet student beside them on the train eats people to stay alive. You are a student in the 20th Ward, with a part-time job and a flat near the station. The Commission of Counter Ghoul has started walking…

wd.vibe: Cold, close and watchful, with the real danger always one street away. People speak in favors and half-truths, and they say the ordinary thing while meaning the frightening one.

b: New York, present day. When Thanos came, every Avenger who was not a spider-person died in the fighting: Tony Stark, Steve Rogers, Thor and the rest of the team are gone, and their tower stands empty over Midtown. What keeps the city running now is a small group of spider-people, Peter Parker, Gwen…

wd.vibe: tense and tired, warm at the edges; people deflect with jokes and settle debts with favors, and nobody says the thing they are afraid of
